style: Picture-book fairy tale look, like a modern illustrated edition of The Three Little Pigs. Rounded friendly characters, expressive faces, never scary.

assets.name: pig
assets.prompt: A small cheerful pink pig in blue overalls standing upright, facing the viewer, smiling, front view, full body.

assets.name: pig-shock
assets.prompt: The same pig, surprised: wide eyes, mouth open, hands up.

assets.name: pig-wet
assets.prompt: The same pig, soaking wet and grumpy, water dripping from ears and overalls.

assets.name: pig-cold
assets.prompt: The same pig shivering in the cold, hugging itself, slightly blue cheeks, frosty breath.

assets.name: pig-cozy
assets.prompt: The same pig sitting wrapped in a red blanket, holding a steaming mug, very content.

assets.name: pig-wave
assets.prompt: The same pig waving hello happily with one hand raised.

assets.name: wolf
assets.prompt: A lanky grey cartoon wolf standing on two legs in a scruffy brown vest, side view facing right, sly but goofy grin. Silly, not scary.

assets.name: wolf-huff
assets.prompt: The same wolf, side view facing right, cheeks puffed up enormously, chest swollen, about to blow.

assets.name: wolf-blow
assets.prompt: The same wolf, side view facing right, blowing as hard as it can, lips pursed, fur and vest flapping.

assets.name: wolf-dizzy
assets.prompt: The same wolf flat on its back, exhausted and dizzy, tongue out, legs in the air.

assets.name: meadow
assets.prompt: Wide landscape background: soft rolling green hills, a few round trees at the far edges, a dirt path, a big sky with gentle clouds. The middle foreground is empty open grass where a house will be placed. 16:9.

assets.name: room
assets.prompt: Cozy inside of a tiny pig's cottage: plank floor, a small rug, a wooden chair and a little window. Empty center for a character. Square.
